The proof, not the enumeration, establishes all quantifiers.

value.rationale: The 2026 idempotent-free but nonsolvable example motivates the higher-iterate question: an absence of idempotents need not mean absence of periodic elements. The complete m-dependent fixed-point and exact cycle spectra across all parameters and odd finite fields reveal a sharp, genuinely arithmetic resonance at lambda=2: every nonzero least period is divisible by p. The q-independent orbit parametrization and exact periodic-locus size provide a natural dynamical invariant beyond a textbook restatement of the known F_1 equation.
